description: This PHP source file defines the RequestParams class within the OrangeHRM project's API version 2, responsible for handling request parameters such as body, attributes, and query parameters, and providing various getter methods for retrieving and sanitizing these parameters, including support for complex types like attachments, date-times, and SVG sanitization.
external_files: Request (assumed class representing an HTTP request)

classes.name: RequestParams
classes.description: A class that encapsulates retrieval and validation of request parameters from different sources (body, attributes, query) in OrangeHRM's API v2, supporting a variety of data types and sanitization, including special handling for SVG content and date-time conversions.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter from specified type collection, with a default fallback.

methods.name: getStringOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter or null if empty and allowed.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter, throws exception if empty string.

methods.name: getIntOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter or null if empty.

methods.name: getFloat
methods.description: Retrieves a float parameter with default fallback.

methods.name: getFloatOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a float parameter or null if empty.

methods.name: getBooleanOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter or null if absent.

methods.name: getArrayOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves an array parameter or null.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves an attachment object, possibly sanitized SVG content.

methods.name: getAttachmentOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves an attachment or null, sanitizing SVG if necessary.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves a DateTime object, applying timezone if provided.

methods.name: getDateTimeOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a parameter exists in the specified collection.
